title: 给导航起对名字
summary: 「做个导航栏」只说了有一排链接。先按放在哪、怎么打开、滚的时候干什么选模型（吸顶 / 侧栏 / 面包屑 / 下拉 / 巨型 / 抽屉 / 全屏 / 锚点 / 收缩），再谈外观。
summaryEn: “Make a navbar” only says there is a row of links. Pick the model by placement, reveal, and scroll — sticky, sidebar, breadcrumb, dropdown, mega, drawer, overlay, scrollspy, or shrink — then talk about the skin.
